title: COOODE: Code One of Ones
tagline: a code sandbox where you can get creative and mint anything you make
description: Tap into your creative side! 🎨 cOoOde a One of One piece with HTML and CSS and MINT it as an NFT to share your art with the world. 🌐 I built this because I wanted to give people a fun environment to experiment with coding and creating. Coding is fun and it's satisfying to MINT what you make.
how_its_made: This project is built with React. I used react-moralis to authenticate users with wallet logins on the frontend. There are 2 code editors (HTML and CSS) that I bootstrapped with Codemirror. This sandbox environment updates to reflect user code changes in real time. Minting is done with NFT Port's easy mint onto the Polygon blockchain. From there you can see the transaction in polyscan and see the end result in Opensea.
